WITH funding_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>') AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc q
  JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>')
)
SELECT fundflux,
       qc_count,
       qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       qc_count::numeric / AVG(qc_count) OVER () AS multiple_of_average
FROM funding_counts;
